# Alwin Madhu (Jeen)

> Alwin Madhu, also known as Jeen, is an independent developer and researcher from Kerala, India. He works across computational drug discovery, peer-to-peer mesh networking, local AI systems, and privacy-respecting health technology. He is pursuing a BCA at Manipal University Jaipur.

## Identity

- Name: Alwin Madhu
- Alias: Jeen / j_e_e_n._
- Website: https://alwin-m.github.io/Portfolio/
- GitHub: https://github.com/alwin-m
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0008-2826-5082
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/j_e_e_n._/

## Projects

- [LIORA](https://alwin-m.github.io/Portfolio/projects/liora/): Privacy-first menstrual wellness and cycle tracking app using the Hathaway Algorithm.
- [SCREAM](https://alwin-m.github.io/Portfolio/projects/scream/): Experimental peer-to-peer mobile messaging concept using Bluetooth and Wi-Fi Direct.
- [Genome Sentinel](https://alwin-m.github.io/Portfolio/projects/genome-sentinel/): Computational drug discovery platform combining AI-assisted research with molecular docking.
- [Liora](https://alwin-m.github.io/Portfolio/projects/liora/): Health technology project focused on private, user-controlled cycle data.
- [ROS-Cycle-Project](https://alwin-m.github.io/Portfolio/projects/roscycle/): Minimal web-based cycle tracker.
- [Megamind](https://alwin-m.github.io/Portfolio/projects/megamind/): Local voice assistant and personal AI experiment.
- [Hathaway Algorithm](https://alwin-m.github.io/Portfolio/research/hathaway-algorithm/): Research page for a Bayesian/Markov menstrual-cycle forecasting model.
